# kairos-expo

Kairos, rebuilt ground-up in Expo: journal-first (the journal tab is home), two tabs plus search, iOS + Android. The pivot and its decisions (D1–D9) live in the commons: `zojercommons/projects/kairos/specs/2026-08-05-kairos-expo-pivot-design.md`. daoUI is the design-system source of truth (D9).

# Expo HAS CHANGED

Read the exact versioned docs at https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/ before writing any code.

## daoUI is the source of truth — generated files are never edited by hand

`src/theme/tokens.gen.ts`, `src/theme/type.gen.ts`, `src/theme/fonts.gen.ts`, and `assets/fonts/` are GENERATED from `../daoUI` by `npm run sync-tokens` / `npm run sync-type` / `npm run sync-fonts` and committed with a provenance stamp. daoUI is in progress; this repo tracks it by **re-syncing**, never by hand-editing generated files. (zhouyi's hand-extracted `colors.gen.ts` is the documented anti-pattern.) If `../daoUI` is absent, set `DAOUI_PATH`. Each gen file's header names the daoUI commit it came from — re-run the script and diff to answer "has this drifted?"

Type is a scale ramp, not a semantic table (daoUI type canon, 2026-08-05): `theme.type.whyteSm`, `theme.type.fraktionXxs` — the family carries the voice, the step carries the size. The semantic names (`display`/`title`/`heading`/`body`…) are dead upstream and a test here keeps them dead.

## CNG — the native folders are build artifacts

`ios/` and `android/` are gitignored and regenerated by `expo prebuild`. Never hand-edit them; anything they need belongs in `app.json` or a config plugin. iOS signing survives prebuild via `plugins/with-signing.js` (`APPLE_TEAM_ID` env overrides the studio default) — hand-set teams are wiped by prebuild and that failure has cost a debugging pass twice already.

## jest

`jest.config.js` EXTENDS jest-expo's `transformIgnorePatterns`, never replaces it wholesale (replacing silently drops the preset's own entries). Add packages that need transforming to `extraTransformedPackages` in `jest.config.js`.

## Verify before committing

`npm run typecheck && npm test`. `expo-env.d.ts` is generated (by `expo start`/`export`/prebuild) and gitignored; if `tsc` fails on files nobody touched, that file is missing — run any expo command that generates it.

## Platform idiom

Navigation, motion, gestures, and system chrome follow `zojercommons/practices/platform-idiom/practice.md`: the platform owns the mechanics, the studio owns the surface. Get platform behavior **by structure** (the tab bar's glass, the separated search accessory, `hidesBottomBarWhenPushed` are all free); name the platform idiom you're declining before hand-rolling any interaction. Concretely: never set `backgroundColor` on the NativeTabs bar — it paints over the glass material.

## Fonts

The studio faces (ABC Whyte, PP Fraktion) are commercially licensed. Coverage for kairos-expo as a newly shipping app is David's to confirm before App Store submission (D9).
